title: Powell signals openness to a September cut as labor data softens
body: Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell told an audience of economists on Tuesday that policymakers see room to ease if inflation continues to cool, pointing to a run of weaker payrolls reports. Traders raised the odds of a rate cut at the next meeting.

title: Shutdown talks collapse as leadership walks out of budget meeting
body: Negotiators from both chambers left a closed-door session without a funding framework Wednesday night, with less than three weeks remaining before the current continuing resolution expires. Aides described the room as tense and unproductive.

title: Pop star announces separation after four years of marriage
body: A representative for the singer confirmed the split in a brief statement Thursday, citing irreconcilable differences. The couple, who married in a widely covered ceremony, share no children.

title: Core inflation reading comes in below forecasts, easing pressure on the Fed
body: The Bureau of Labor Statistics reported Thursday that core consumer prices rose 0.2% in August, below the 0.3% economists had projected. The softer print gives the Federal Reserve more room to cut rates at its next meeting without stoking inflation fears.

title: Congress reaches last-minute deal to keep government open through October
body: House and Senate leaders announced a short-term funding agreement late Friday, averting a shutdown that had looked increasingly likely earlier in the week. The bill funds the government through the end of October and now heads to the president's desk.

title: Georgia Senate runoff heads to December after no candidate clears 50%
body: Neither candidate reached the majority threshold required under state law, triggering a runoff election set for early December. Both campaigns have already begun rebooking ad time in the Atlanta media market.

title: Overnight house fire displaces family of four, no injuries reported
body: Firefighters responded to a two-alarm blaze shortly after midnight and had the fire under control within an hour. The Red Cross is assisting the family with temporary housing while investigators determine the cause.

title: Local high school claims first state basketball championship in school history
body: The team closed out the season with a 58-52 win in the state final, capping an undefeated run. Fans lined the streets for a celebration parade Monday afternoon.
